name: zanker-accessibility-audit
description: Audit semantic controls, keyboard interaction, contrast and WCAG-related requirements.

workflow.instruction: Run available automated accessibility tools such as @axe-core/playwright if project has them.
Inspect labels, focus, keyboard flow, reduced motion, error feedback and status announcements.
Map findings to exact WCAG 2.2 success criteria where appropriate.
State what automated checks cannot verify and require manual/assistive-tech testing.

acceptance: No claims of total WCAG compliance from automation
fallback: Provide manual test checklist and mark untested cases.
